meta.decode: physical value = encoded uint16 * scale + offset; 65535 means no data
meta.order: C order; north-to-south rows; west-to-east columns
meta.coordinates: latitude=89.75-row*0.5; longitude=-179.75+column*0.5; source C-order mask; 4225 supplied latitudes verified
meta.longitudeConvention: Standard west-to-east cell centers inferred from the global grid; no explicit longitude vector is bundled

interpolation.method: Inverse squared great-circle distance from four original source cells
interpolation.restriction: Target and all donors must lie on Natural Earth land; sampled direct paths may not cross ocean; donors must surround target (no bearing gap >180 degrees)
interpolation.purpose: Visualization only; original cells retained; unsupported land remains nodata; no recursive filling or extrapolation across large gaps

meta.coastlinePolicy: Original ED cells are retained even when their centers fall outside Natural Earth land; these cells never seed interpolation

land.name: Natural Earth 1:50m land
land.rasterization: Even-odd polygon intersection at exact 0.5-degree cell centers, including polygon holes

meta.display: Physical values are not color-clipped in this asset; renderers may apply their own color scales. Interpolated cells are distinct from ED reference outputs.
